summary: STANDARDS THE DATASHEET INVOKES, on the vendor's word: (1) I2C-bus - DS13510 Table 8 p.18/198 footnote 1 verbatim 'Data based on standard I2C protocol requirement, not tested in production.' and footnote 2 'Data for I2C fast mode and I2C fast mode plus have been validated by characterization, not tested in production.' - fast mode 400 kHz, fast mode plus 1000 kHz; (2) MIPI I3C v1.1 (cover p.1 'SPI / I2C & MIPI I3C v1.1 serial interface'); (3) SPI modes 0 and 3 (p.21); (4) 'ECOPACK and RoHS' - Section 18 p.174 'The LGA package is compliant with the ECOPACK and RoHS standard.' and cover 'ECOPACK and RoHS compliant'. The artifact is the datasheet itself (docs/datasheet.pdf is a symlink to the folder-root datasheet.pdf that PROVENANCE.json hashes). CANNOT DETERMINE because nothing was measured in this workshop and the datasheet's own words are 'not tested in production'; recorded so a bus check knows which timing table (Table 8) governs the imu_to_dxl I2C lines if that board uses I2C - which is itself unknown.

PACKAGE OUTLINE RE-SOURCED FROM THE MECHANICAL DRAWING THAT WAS ALREADY IN THIS FOLDER. The 2026-09-02 package_outline row cited the ST PRODUCT PAGE ('LGA 14L', '2.5 mm x 3 mm x 0.83 mm') and recorded the land grid as CANNOT DETERMINE, saying the drawing in DS13510 was 'NOT on disk in this folder today'. It was: DS13510 Rev 4 section 19.1, Figure 33 'LGA-14L 2.5 x 3.0 x 0.86 mm package outline and mechanical data', PAGE 175 of 198 of the datasheet.pdf this folder's PROVENANCE.json already hashed (sha256 ec53c0e5..., re-fetched from st.com 2026-09-03 and byte-identical). Read off that drawing: OUTER DIMENSIONS table L 2.50 +/-0.1, W 3.00 +/-0.1, H 0.86 MAX; general tolerance +/-0.1 mm unless otherwise specified; land grid 14 lands, pitch 0.5, each land 0.25 +/-0.05 x 0.475 +/-0.05, land rows 1.5 apart, 4x (0.1) reference corner feature, flatness 0.05 to datum C, pin 1 indicated on TOP and BOTTOM views. TWO CHANGES: the height is 0.8600 MAX and not 0.8300 - the 0.83 appears nowhere on the drawing, has no stated basis, and is 0.0300 mm SMALLER than the drawing's maximum, the wrong direction for a clearance check; and the land grid moves CANNOT DETERMINE -> measured. STILL CANNOT DETERMINE, unchanged: the land PATTERN a board should etch (the drawing's own note sends a reader to ST technical note TN0018, a separate document not in this folder) and the orientation of the package on Pollen's unpublished imu_to_dxl v2.
kind_note: recorded as 'standard' because that is the vocabulary bin/triad accepts (sim|bench|field|standard|use|failure|export) and this row is a reading of a vendor's own published document, which is what every other datasheet row in this shelf uses. It was first written as 'dimension', which bin/triad check FAILED as an unknown kind; corrected before the row was ever committed, so nothing append-only was rewritten. The vocabulary has no term for a dimension read off a drawing — that is a gap in TRIAD.md's ledger schema, not in this row.

summary: CORRECTION TO THE ROW ABOVE, SAME DAY, SAME LANE. That row said the LSM6DSV16X's 0.83 mm height 'appears nowhere on the drawing and carries no stated basis' and called it a product-page figure. THE FIRST HALF IS TRUE AND THE SECOND IS FALSE. 0.83 is the vendor's own TYP and it is printed three times inside the very PDF this folder hashes: cover page 1 of 198, verbatim '(2.5 x 3.0 x 0.83 mm) typ.' and 'Compact footprint: 2.5 mm x 3 mm x 0.83 mm', and section 1 page 11 'a small plastic land grid array (LGA) package of 2.5 x 3.0 x 0.83 mm'. The drawing's 0.86 is a MAX (Figure 33 OUTER DIMENSIONS, page 175). A typ and a max of the same package, 0.0300 mm apart, do not contradict each other, and this repo already held both: ELECTRONICS-DATASHEET.html quotes the cover's 0.83 typ AND Figure 33's 0.86 max and says so. HOW THIS WAS CAUGHT: not by re-reading the drawing but by grepping the rest of the repo for the number before publishing, which found the document that already knew. WHAT STANDS: body_mm carries 0.8600 because a maximum is what an enclosure must clear; body_h_typ_mm 0.83 and body_h_max_mm 0.86 are now both on the interface row with their pages. The previous row is NOT edited - the ledger is append-only and this supersedes it.
